# MoonwellArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/MoonwellArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[Ark](../ark.md)

**Title:**
MoonwellArk

Ark contract for managing token supply and yield generation through any Moonwell-compliant mToken.

Implements strategy for depositing tokens, withdrawing tokens, and tracking yield from Moonwell vaults.


## State Variables
### mToken
The Moonwell-compliant mToken this Ark interacts with


```solidity
IMToken public immutable mToken
```


### comptroller

```solidity
IComptroller public immutable comptroller
```

```solidity
constructor(address _mToken, ArkParams memory _params) Ark(_params);
```

|----|----|-----------|
|`_mToken`|`address`|Address of the Moonwell-compliant mToken|
|`_params`|`ArkParams`|ArkParams struct containing necessary parameters for Ark initialization|


### totalAssets

Returns the total assets managed by this Ark in the Moonwell mToken


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256 assets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The total balance of underlying assets held in the mToken for this Ark|


### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

MoonwellArk is always withdrawable


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```

### _harvest

Internal function for harvesting rewards

This function is a no-op for most Moonwell vaults as they automatically accrue interest


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardTokens`|`address[]`|The addresses of the reward tokens|
|`rewardAmounts`|`uint256[]`|The amounts of the reward tokens|
